title: Shadow Queries for Private Retrieval in Vector Databases
abstract: arXiv:2609.04767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on information retrieval (IR) systems, such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), to incorporate domain-specific knowledge without costly re-training. These systems often store pre-computed document embeddings in cloud-based vector databases. However, such embeddings are vulnerable to embedding inversion attacks (EIAs), which can reconstruct their underlying text. Existing defenses, such as adding noise or scaling embeddings, often provide limited privacy or significantly reduce retrieval utility.   We propose SHAQ (shadow query generation), a semantic-decomposition and embedding-decoupling defense against EIAs. SHAQ is based on the insight that EIAs rely on the strong coupling between an embedding and its original text. translated_title: 面向向量数据库私有检索的影子查询方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型日益依赖信息检索系统（如检索增强生成，RAG），以便在无需昂贵重新训练的情况下引入特定领域的知识。这些系统通常将预先计算的文档嵌入存储在云端向量数据库中。然而，此类嵌入容易受到嵌入反演攻击（EIAs）的威胁，攻击者可以据此重建其底层文本。现有的防御手段（如添加噪声或缩放嵌入）往往只能提供有限的隐私保护，或显著降低检索效用。我们提出了 SHAQ（影子查询生成），这是一种针对嵌入反演攻击的语义分解与嵌入解耦防御方法。SHAQ 的核心洞察在于：嵌入反演攻击依赖于嵌入与其原始文本之间的强耦合关系。SHAQ 不直接存储文档嵌入，而是利用生成式语言模型创建多样化的影子查询，以捕捉每个文档的不同语义方面……
tldr: 提出 SHAQ 防御方法，利用生成式语言模型将文档嵌入解耦为捕捉不同语义方面的多样化影子查询，破坏嵌入与原文之间的强耦合，从而有效防御嵌入反演攻击并保护云端向量数据库中的文档隐私。
en_tdlr: We propose SHAQ, a defense against embedding inversion attacks that uses a generative language model to decompose document embeddings into diverse shadow queries capturing different semantic aspects, thereby decoupling embeddings from their original text to protect document privacy in cloud-based vector databases.
